name: floating-tab-bar
title: Floating tab bar
description: A floating, pill-shaped tab bar for mobile web: only the current tab shows its label, five fit in 320px, and it clears the home indicator.
docs: Pass items (id, label, icon, href, badge), current and onSelect. Only the current item shows its label, with an animated width that is instant under reduced motion; the other items are icons that keep their label as the accessible name, so three to five destinations fit on a phone. badge is a count or true for a dot, from NotificationBadge. The bar is fixed to the bottom and pads for the safe area (the page needs viewport-fit=cover in its viewport meta for the inset to have a value); to pin it inside a frame instead, pass className="absolute" to a positioned parent. hideOnScroll slides it away while the page scrolls down and brings it back on any upward move, at the top of the page, and when a key brings focus into it; scrollRef names an element that scrolls instead of the page, and it must exist before the bar. With linkAs it renders in a Server Component (only the scroll behaviour is client code); onSelect is a function, so use it from a Client Component.
